description: This file defines a static class 'Locks' providing thread synchronization functions for the PDFsharp library, particularly managing locks related to GDI+ and FontFactory operations to ensure thread safety.

classes.name: Locks
classes.description: Provides static methods for managing GDI+ and FontFactory locks to facilitate thread safety within the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: EnterGdiPlus
methods.description: Acquires the lock for GDI+ operations and increments the lock count. Logs a critical error if the font factory lock is already held by the current thread.

methods.name: ExitGdiPlus
methods.description: Releases the GDI+ lock and decrements the lock count.

methods.name: IsGdiPlusLockedByCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread holds the GDI+ lock.

methods.name: IsGdiPlusLookTaken
methods.description: Returns true if the GDI+ lock count indicates the lock is taken.

methods.name: EnterFontFactory
methods.description: Acquires the FontFactory lock and increments its lock count. Logs a critical error if GDI+ lock is already held by the current thread.

methods.name: ExitFontFactory
methods.description: Releases the FontFactory lock and decrements its lock count.

methods.name: IsFontFactoryLockedByCurrentThread
methods.description: Checks if the current thread holds the FontFactory lock.

methods.name: IsFontFactoryLookTaken
methods.description: Returns true if the FontFactory lock count indicates it is taken.
